order 0,1,2,3,4; g = id; L = 6 · certificate accepted by brehm_cpp check (R1–R6)

Image F(D) at the same scale: all cells translucent, no layer order
x from −1 to 1, y from −1 to 1
boundary of the paper and its image
crease: the two maps differ (46 pieces); M/V not assigned
auxiliary edge: one map on both sides (0 pieces)
Cells covering a point (shading only; it saturates):

Coordinates are rounded to 0.001 px when drawn; the certificate, not this figure, is the mathematical object.
Labels: cell indices and point indices k of a_k ↦ b_k (0-based). No layer order is drawn or implied.
